dedupe_keys.name: youtube dataset on mobile streaming for internet traffic modeling network management and streaming analysis

description: This mobile YouTube streaming dataset, published by Frank Loh and colleagues, links network traffic with playback behaviour for Internet-traffic modelling and streaming analysis. The Figshare record describes 1,081 hours of measurements across 80 scenarios and 171 bandwidth settings. A ZIP package includes measurements and supporting material; its public README identifies a CSV overview, bandwidth-setting list, phase-detection explanation and Python scripts for packet extraction, playback-statistics processing and plotting. Version 2 was published in April 2022. Geographic coverage is limited to the experimental setup; the inspected metadata does not identify a service area, complete campaign dates or a single common sampling interval. The data are freely accessible under CC BY 4.0. Controlled bandwidth settings and the tested player and software versions limit transfer to current applications or unmanaged networks. The observations can inform streaming-demand models, access-network capacity planning and traffic-phase validation. They complement data-cesnet-backbone-traffic-datasets by describing application-level playback alongside traffic, whereas CESNET records traffic on backbone links. No direct interface to a simulator was tested.
